verdicts.reason: Both are near-identical shrunk copies of the original crammed into a tiny banner: the event details on the right are reduced to illegibly small, ragged right-aligned text pushed against the canvas edge, and the stained-glass window shrinks to a minor icon. A leaves slightly more breathing room around the window and the right block; in B the window crowds the headline and the date/address text sits even tighter against the right edge.
